environment.description: Same IoT gateway binary deployed via container runtime (containerd 1.6.x) with an OCI runtime spec that includes a custom seccomp profile loaded from /etc/containerd/seccomp-iot-restrictive.json. The profile uses SCMP_ACT_KILL_PROCESS as defaultAction with an allowlist architecture filter for SCMP_ARCH_AARCH64. The syscall allowlist permits: read, write, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, ioctl, access, poll, recvfrom, sendto, bind, getsockname, getpeername, setsockopt, clone (with CLONE_THREAD only), exit_group, futex, epoll_wait, epoll_ctl, openat (with RESOLVE_BENEATH flag enforcement via arg filter), and nanosleep. Notably ABSENT from allowlist: execve, execveat, fork, vfork, clone (without CLONE_THREAD), ptrace, socket (new socket creation blocked - existing inherited fd permitted), connect, accept. The profile also sets SCMP_FLTATR_CTL_NNP=1 (no-new-privileges). Process runs as uid 65534 (nobody) with CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE only capability retained, all others dropped including CAP_SYS_ADMIN and CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE.

config.runtime: containerd 1.6.x with custom OCI seccomp profile
